summary.text: Greg Martin is a Republican state representative from Hamilton County who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 26 since April 2022, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Greg Martin graduated from Hixson High School, earned a B.A. from Bryan College, and received master's and doctoral degrees from New Orleans Baptist Theological Seminary.
He began working as family service manager for Lakewood Memory Gardens and Hamilton County Memorial Park in 1999.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Martin said he had been a county commissioner and a member of the Hamilton County school board for District 3, had served on the Long Beach, Mississippi, school board from 1993 to 1996, and was a realtor with Berkshire Home Services Realty Center.
Ballotpedia lists him as taking office on April 4, 2022, and in the same survey he said he was appointed to the unexpired District 26 term in March 2022.
In that survey, Martin named public safety, economic development and jobs, and public education as his key campaign messages, and he said he was passionate about addressing drug overdoses.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Local Government, Transportation, and Government Operations committees.
